arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data from Treasury Bulletin - computed annual interest charge on public debt
# FY 1961-1967 (t=0 in FY 1961)
years = [1961, 1962, 1963, 1964, 1965, 1966, 1967]
interest = [3072, 3240, 3361, 3561, 3678, 3988, 4039]

# t = 0 in FY 1961, so t values are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
t = [y - 1961 for y in years]
print("t values:", t)
print("Interest values (millions):", interest)

# OLS: y = a + bt
# Calculate slope and intercept
n = len(t)
sum_t = sum(t)
sum_y = sum(interest)
sum_tt = sum([ti*ti for ti in t])
sum_ty = sum([t[i]*interest[i] for i in range(n)])

slope = (n * sum_ty - sum_t * sum_y) / (n * sum_tt - sum_t * sum_t)
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_t) / n

print(f"\nOLS: y = {intercept:.4f} + {slope:.4f}t")

# Predict FY 1968 (t = 7)
t_1968 = 7
forecast_1968 = intercept + slope * t_1968
print(f"\nForecast for FY 1968: {forecast_1968:.2f} million dollars")

# Actual FY 1968 value
actual_1968 = 4499  # from table
print(f"Actual FY 1968: {actual_1968} million dollars")

# Forecast error
error = forecast_1968 - actual_1968
print(f"\nForecast error = {error:.2f} million dollars")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(error, 2)}")
EOF
